artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: This image displays an engraved portrait of the upper half of Sir Walter Raleigh's body. He is depicted in a seated position, facing slightly to the right but looking forward. His features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a pointed goatee, and a mustache. His hair is wavy and styled back. Sir Walter Raleigh is dressed in an elaborately detailed Elizabethan outfit with a ruffed collar, a patterned doublet, and decorative buttons on the shoulder. The cuffs of his garment are trimmed with lace. His right hand holds a staff or cylinder. The background features an oval frame with an inscription identifying him and decorative elements like scrolls and an emblematic design. Text below the portrait provides additional context.

artworks.title: Aaron Rathborne
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a pointed beard, mustache, and graying hair combed back. He wears an elaborate costume with a lace ruff collar, patterned sleeves, and a striped outer garment. In his right hand, he holds a quill pen, with an open book on the table in front of him. Various instruments are on the table. The background has an ornate frame with Latin inscription and decorative elements. The engraving is monochromatic with fine lines and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Aaron Rathborne
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man seated from the waist up. His body is slightly turned to the right as he looks directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, including a trimmed beard and mustache, with short, slicked-back hair. He wears a high-collared lace neck ruffle and a textured cloak over an embroidered garment. In his left hand, he holds a pair of compasses above an open book. The background shows an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions and scrollwork. To the left, there are shelves with books, and various scientific instruments like globes and measuring devices are visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Ludovic Stuart, Duke of Lennox and Richmond
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body inside an oval medallion. The man is facing forward with his head turned slightly to the left. He has distinct facial features, a full beard, and a mustache. His hair is short and wavy. He wears a detailed garment with a high lace collar, a velvet cloak with embroidery, and an ornate chain around his neck. He holds a baton or staff in his hand. The background features heraldic elements like crests or shields. Below the portrait, there is decorative text detailing the person's title and achievements within the ornate border.

artworks.title: Ludovic Stuart, Duke of Lennox and Richmond
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is positioned facing slightly to his left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a closely cropped beard and a mustache with a high forehead, short curly hair, and is wearing elaborate clothing, including an ornate jacket and a large, ruffled collar. He is adorned with a chain of office around his neck and is holding a baton or scepter in his right hand. Surrounding the portrait is an intricately designed border with heraldic symbols, and beneath the portrait, there is an inscription of text in an elegant calligraphic style. The background behind him is textured.

artworks.title: Captain John Smith
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of Captain John Smith in an elaborate engraving style. He is seen from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a mustache, full beard, straight nose, and strong jawline. His hair is wavy and relatively short. He is wearing period attire with a high lace collar and a buttoned doublet with puffed sleeves. He is holding the pommel of a sword in his right hand. The portrait is framed with text at the top, and a small globe rests above his head on a pedestal. Grid-like lines and illustrations of a soldier and a man on horseback are in the background, conveying themes of exploration and conquest.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, who is seated and facing slightly towards the viewer's left. The man has a distinguished facial expression, with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He has short hair beneath a tall, wide-brimmed hat that sits firmly on his head. He is dressed in an elaborate outfit typical of the early 17th century, featuring a richly fur-trimmed cloak and a ruffled lace collar. In his right hand, he is holding a rolled document, and there appears to be a map or document partially visible in his left hand. The background features intricate scrollwork framing the subject's head and shoulders, with ships and nautical imagery suggesting exploration or maritime context. Beneath the portrait is text describing the individual's titles and achievements, along with a decorative crest.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Smith
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man sitting down holding a scroll. He has a furrowed brow, a mustache, and a beard. The man wears a high-collared ruff, a dark wide-brimmed hat, a fur-trimmed garment, and intricately detailed clothing. In the background, there is an oval frame with Latin text. Below the portrait, there is detailed script in English describing his titles and associations, along with a coat of arms and a decorative illustration of a ship.

artworks.title: Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man in a three-quarters view, looking slightly to the right. He has detailed facial features with a mustache, beard, and curly hair. He wears an elaborate lace ruff around his neck, and a richly detailed garment with a dark sash. There is a chain with a decorative pendant around his neck and chest. The portrait is set in an oval frame with intricate background lines. The frame contains Latin text identifying the individual and his titles.

artworks.title: Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset
artworks.artist: Andries Jacobsz Stock after Simon de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right, with his head turned toward the viewer, providing a three-quarter view of his face. The man has distinct facial features with a neatly trimmed beard and curly hair that frames his head, extending down to his ears. He is wearing an elaborate ruffled collar and a richly detailed jacket that includes a sash across his chest. Around his neck, he has a chain with a pendant. The image is framed within an oval border, and outside this oval, there is text inscribed, which includes "ROBERTUS CAR COMES SOMERSET" around the perimeter. The background of the image is crosshatched, giving a sense of depth and emphasizing the engraved style of the portrait. The surrounding area contains inscriptions in multiple languages, providing elaborate textual elements above and below the image.

artworks.title: Frances, Countess of Somerset
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a person seated, facing forward with their head slightly tilted to the side. The person has distinct facial features, with a small mouth and wide eyes, and their hair is styled into voluminous, curly locks with an ornate headdress or accessory. They are dressed in an elaborate outfit with a high ruffled collar, lace, and intricate details, including a visible necklace. The background of the image is a textured oval frame with the text identifying the portrait as Lady Francis, Countess of Somerset. The overall palette is monochrome, and the portrait is encased within a detailed border.

artworks.title: Frances, Countess of Somerset
artworks.description: The image shows a person in an upper-body portrait, seated in a forward-facing position. The individual has delicate facial features with soft eyes and a small mouth. They wear a large hat with a feather and an elaborate dress with lace, ruffles, and ornate detailing, along with a decorative necklace. The background features an oval frame with engravings around the border on textured paper.

artworks.title: Henry Wriothersley, Third Earl of Southampton
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man from the waist up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a mustache and a neatly trimmed beard. His hair is curly and well-groomed, extending down to his collar. He wears a lace collar and a richly decorated outfit with ornate designs. Strap-like accessories cross his chest, and he holds a staff in his right hand. The background features a decorative oval frame with scroll-like adornments and text around the upper part, with a coat of arms integrated into the design at the top. The bottom section includes a decorative ribbon with inscribed text.

artworks.title: Edward Cecil, Viscount Wimbledon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a half-length portrait. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has short hair, a trimmed mustache, and a pointed goatee. The man is wearing intricate clothing with patterns and lace, including a high, ruffled collar. In his right hand, he holds a baton. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with ribbons, trumpets, and a coat of arms at the top. The background is a finely detailed engraving with inscriptions and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Edward Somerset, Fourth Earl of Worcester
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in ornate attire. He is positioned at a slight angle with a dignified expression, gazing forward. The man has a bearded face, short hair, and is wearing a richly decorated garment with a ruffled collar. He holds a medallion or pendant, and the background features detailed line work. The portrait is framed with decorative elements and text.

artworks.title: Edward Somerset, Fourth Earl of Worcester
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned frontally and gazes directly at the viewer. His facial features include a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, a receding hairline, and prominent eyebrows. He wears a large ruff around his neck, a richly adorned garment with floral patterns, and a cape draped from his shoulders. A chain with a large medallion hangs down the center of his chest. The background features elaborate scrollwork, inscriptions framing the figure, and a crest at the top.

artworks.title: Edward Somerset, Fourth Earl of Worcester
artworks.description: This image shows a man seated with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a beard and mustache, is bald on top with hair on the sides, and is wearing a richly embroidered garment with a high collar. A lace collar surrounds his neck, and he wears a medallion on a chain. His right hand is slightly forward, and the background features decorative elements and text detailing his titles and ranks. Above his head is a crest or coat of arms. The image is in a black and white engraving style.

artworks.title: Sir John Hayward, Historian
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man in an engraving. He faces the viewer with his body slightly turned. He has a high forehead, prominent eyebrows, a long pointed beard, short hair with a part on the side, and a receding hairline. He wears a detailed jacket with decorative buttons, a high lace collar, and holds a rolled document in his right hand. In the background, there is a patterned texture and a coat of arms in the upper right corner. Below the portrait are two small scenes with allegorical figures: one being attacked by a monstrous figure, and the other being cared for by another individual who is washing or anointing them. The engraving includes the text “FLY FROM EVEL DOE GOOD.”

artworks.title: Henry Rich, First Earl of Holland
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a bust portrait of a man. He is semi-profile, with distinct facial features such as high cheekbones, a mustache, and a neatly groomed beard or goatee. His period hairstyle is wavy and styled back. He is dressed in elaborate period clothing including armor with intricate detailing, and wears a pleated ruff around his neck. The armor includes decorative shoulder plates and gauntlets. In the background, the image is framed by an oval border with Latin text identifying him. The sides feature ornamental details with helmets and lances. Below the portrait, cursive text identifies him as Henry Rich, a knight and captain.

artworks.title: Henry Rich, First Earl of Holland
artworks.description: This image depicts a portrait of a man from the waist up within an oval frame. The man faces slightly left and has medium-length, light, wavy hair styled back, a neat mustache, and a small beard. He wears an elaborate outfit with a high lace collar, a detailed jacket with armor-like elements, and a sash across his chest. His right hand rests on his hip and the background features a crest with heraldic symbols. A Latin inscription surrounds the oval frame, and the lower portion includes a description identifying the man as Henry Rich, Earl of Holland.

artworks.title: Henry Rich, First Earl of Holland
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a formal stance. He is turned slightly to the side with his left hand on his hip. His facial features include a smooth complexion, a prominent nose, and a neat mustache and goatee. His hair is styled in soft waves, falling above shoulder length. He wears ornate armor with intricate detailing, a ruffled collar, and protective arm cuffs. The background features decorative borders with Latin inscriptions, shield, and weapon motifs. The background has fine cross-hatching details.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving focusing on the upper half of a person's body within an oval border. The individual faces forward with a direct gaze, featuring distinctive facial characteristics such as a prominent nose, high forehead, and a small goatee with a mustache. The person's curly hair reaches the collar, partially covered by a feathered hat. They wear ornate clothing, including a patterned fabric and a lace ruff. The frame surrounding the figure includes inscriptions, scrolls, crests, and symbols. The background is plain within the oval, while the border is densely decorated with text and patterns.

artworks.title: James I, King of England and Charles, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one seated and the other standing. The seated figure is a mature man wearing a crown, a cloak with a fur collar, and holding a scepter in his right hand. His left hand rests on a skull in his lap. The standing figure is a younger male with short, slicked-back hair, wearing ornate clothing with an elaborate collar. In his left hand, he holds a skull on a small table beside him. Both figures are dressed in richly decorated attire with intricate patterns and textures. They are set against a detailed backdrop with drapery and a script beneath them.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: This image shows an engraving of a man depicted from the waist up, seated and holding a sword and globe. The man has a stern expression, a beard, mustache, and a crown with intricate patterns. He wears a robe with fur trim and a chain with a pendant. The background features text, titles, and smaller coronet illustrations. The composition is framed with swirling lines and floral motifs.
